description: 家族や友人が公園でピクニックをしている最中に突然強い風が吹き、食べ物や紙皿、ナプキンなどが飛ばされて大混乱になっている。中央では父親が飛ばされそうなピクニックシートを必死に押さえ、母親が倒れそうな飲み物をつかもうとしている。高校生の娘は風で飛ばされた帽子を追いかけ、小さな男の子は地面に落ちたサンドイッチを見て悲しそうにしている。背景では祖母の傘が裏返り、犬が飛んでいく紙袋を追いかけて飼い主を引っ張っている。さらに、木の枝に凧が絡まり、別の家族が急いで荷物を片づけている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a large green urban park during a family picnic on a bright but suddenly very windy afternoon. The main incident must be immediately understandable: a powerful unexpected gust of wind has disrupted the picnic and is blowing lightweight objects in different directions. In the center foreground, a father is kneeling and desperately holding down the corner of a large picnic blanket that is lifting into the air. Paper plates, napkins, paper cups, and food wrappers are being blown away around him. Beside him, the mother looks startled and is reaching forward to catch a plastic drink bottle and two cups that are about to fall over on a low picnic table. Their teenage daughter is running after her hat, which has been blown several meters away by the wind. A young boy is sitting near the picnic blanket and looking extremely disappointed at a sandwich that has fallen face-down onto the grass. Include several distinct background sub-stories happening simultaneously. On the left, an elderly grandmother is struggling with an umbrella that has been blown completely inside out by the strong wind, while another family member tries to help her. On the right, the family's excited dog is pulling hard on its leash while chasing a lightweight paper bag that is blowing across the grass, forcing its owner to lean backward and struggle to control it. In the middle background, a child's kite has become tangled high in the branches of a tree, and the child is pointing upward while an adult looks concerned. Farther back, another family is hurriedly packing food, folding chairs, and bags into a picnic basket before more items blow away. One person is chasing a rolling water bottle. Show trees bending slightly in the wind, leaves flying through the air, picnic baskets, sandwiches, fruit, bottles, paper plates, cups, folding chairs, backpacks, a picnic blanket, an overturned umbrella, a dog, a kite, and several families. All actions, objects, causes, and emotions must be visually clear and easy to describe. The sudden wind must clearly be the cause of the multiple simultaneous problems. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Approximately 10 to 13 visible people plus one dog. No speech bubbles, no captions, no readable brand names, no copyrighted logos or characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive facial expressions and body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.
